artworks.title: Plate 27: A Cross Fox, a Hyena/Baboon, a "Sea Wolf," and a Gulon (Wolverine?)
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of various animals around a tree. The painting includes a fox approaching a rooster on a grassy hill, a dog-like animal on a gnarled tree branch, a boar near water, and another animal at the water’s edge. Latin inscriptions and the Roman numeral XXVII are present above and around the central oval. The artwork may be part of a series, and appears to depict a fable or moral story. The style is reminiscent of Joris Hoefnagel, known for illuminated manuscripts and naturalistic details.

artworks.title: Plate 28: A "Tartarine" (Barbary Macaque?)  with Fruit and a Snail
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: There is a brown monkey, blue grapes, two melons, and a cucumber in the image. The color palette consists of earthy tones with browns, yellows, greens, vibrant blue, and purple. The monkey is on the right side, the grapes are at the top near the center, and the melons and cucumber are towards the bottom left. The monkey is crouched with its hands raised, the grapes hang from a vine, and the fruits are placed along the bottom. Radish leaves are visible on the left, and there are Latin inscriptions above and below the circle.

artworks.title: Plate 2: Two Giraffes with an Attendant
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two giraffe-like creatures and a plant. The image shows two creatures with elongated necks and spotted fur standing on green hills. One creature is smaller and faces a small human figure. The other creature is larger and faces slightly to the side. A plant with a slim stem and pink leaves or flowers is on the far right. The scene is enclosed by an oval line, with a Latin inscription at the bottom.

artworks.title: Plate 29: Two Monkeys, an "Arctopithecus"(Sloth?) and Fruit
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of monkeys and various gourds within a circular frame. The painting features three monkeys in a pastoral scene, one sitting on the ground while the other two are on a tree branch. Surrounding the monkeys are large gourds and a butterfly is perched on one of them. The scene includes a variety of textures, from the fur of the monkeys to the rough surface of the gourds and the smooth branch of the tree. The Latin text adorning the top and bottom of the painting gives it a classical, academic feel. The detailed rendering and composition suggest a style reminiscent of a natural history illustration or a Renaissance period work.

artworks.title: Plate 30: Two Monkeys
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image displays two monkeys, one sitting and holding a fruit, while the other is standing on all fours. The monkeys are depicted in shades of brown, tan, and grey, and the fruits are colored in purple, red, and yellow. The seated monkey is on the left holding a pink fruit, while the standing monkey is on the right facing the seated one. Various fruits are placed along the bottom edge, including a red fruit, apple-like fruits, and a yellow elongated fruit. The scene is enclosed in an oval outline and positioned centrally on a pale background.

artworks.title: Plate 32: Two Monkeys on a Table
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: Two monkeys are on a green tablecloth surrounded by fruits and vegetables. The monkeys have earthy tones, with brown, grey, and black colors. The tablecloth is green, and the fruits show muted reds, purples, and pinks. The monkey on the left is brown, seated close to the center of the table, holding something to its mouth, with its tail curled behind. The monkey on the right has a dark body and a lighter face, sitting upright with its tail spread on the table, facing a round, pink fruit in front. Near the viewer, there is a halved fruit and a turnip-like vegetable on the table. The scene is enclosed in an oval border with Latin text above and below, against a beige background.

artworks.title: Plate 33: A "Simivulpa" (Opossum?) and an Ibex
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of an animal scene. The painting depicts a brown mammal with udders and a black goat with horns, set in a circular composition. Both animals are shown in their respective environments, with a tree branch overhead bearing a green fruit. The background is minimal, drawing focus to the animals and tree. The numeral XXXIII is inscribed on the right side. This style resembles a natural history or scientific illustration from early naturalists.

artworks.title: Plate 34: Three Dogs, Including a "Mimick"
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of two dogs and a white rabbit on a patch of terrain. The central focus of the image is an oval-shaped illustration depicting two distinct dogs and a solitary rabbit. One dog is tall and slender while the other is slightly rotund. The rabbit is shown from behind as it heads away. The artwork is framed by Latin inscriptions and is accompanied by ornate text. The style of the illustration is reflective of medieval manuscript art, with detailed attention to the naturalistic portrayal of animals.

artworks.title: Plate 35: A Hound and a Water Spaniel
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of two dogs near a body of water. The image shows a greyhound-like dog with a slender body and a beige coat, standing next to a shaggy dog with black fur that sits next to a small body of water. The painting is contained within an oval shape, with text in Latin above and below the oval. There is also a Roman numeral 'XXXV' outside the oval on the right side. The ground beneath the dogs is a mix of grass and earth tones, with the suggestion of a shoreline receding into water. The artwork is detailed with attention to the texture of the dogs' fur and the colors on the landscape. The style is illustrative or naturalistic, reminiscent of historical manuscripts or zoological illustrations.

artworks.title: Plate 36: Two Spotted Hounds
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two dogs within an oval frame. One dog is standing on the left with a spotted coat, while the other is seated on the right with a short coat. Both dogs are on grassy terrain with sparse vegetation. Latin text is present above and below the dogs, and the number XXXVI is inscribed to the right of the frame.

artworks.title: Plate 37: Two Spaniels with a Gourd
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two dogs and a cucumber-like plant within an oval frame. The drawing depicts two distinct dogs, each standing on a patch of grass, one on a small cliff and the other on flat ground. Above them hangs a large cucumber-like plant. In addition to this imagery, there are Latin inscriptions on the upper and lower parts of the drawing. The drawing is detailed, with careful attention given to textures. The layout is orderly, typical of an illustrative botanical or zoological study.

artworks.title: Plate 38: Two Small Dogs with a Crown Imperial
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of two dogs, a crowned imperial plant, and a water reflection against a landscape. The slender, reddish-brown dog with a curly tail is on the left by a tree trunk, while the shaggy, gray dog is seated on the right. A crown imperial plant with orange flowers is at the center. A reflective pool is below, and in the background is an illustration of a castle-like structure in greenery.

artworks.title: Plate 3: Camel, Ibex, and Goat
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: The image features a brown camel, an antelope, a reclining deer, and a grazing goat. The color palette is primarily earthy tones such as browns and greens, with hints of blue and black. The camel is at the center, surrounded by the other animals in various positions. The composition is enclosed within an oval frame.

artworks.title: Plate 39: Three Puppies with a Crate and a Bunch of Grapes
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: Three puppies are playing on a patch of grass. They are near a wooden crate, a plant, bananas, and a bunch of grapes hanging above. The color palette includes shades of brown, green, tan, red, and purple.

artworks.title: Plate 40: Two Otters and a Beaver
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of three creatures in a natural setting by the water's edge. The painting features two creatures standing on a small landmass that juts into a body of water. One creature is slightly elevated above the ground with a long, sleek body and pointed snout facing left. The other creature is standing at the shoreline, with its head lifted. In the water to the left, partially submerged, another creature is holding a fish. The background is minimally detailed, focusing on the blue-green hues of the water and subtle vegetation on the land. Latin text is written above the illustration.

artworks.title: Plate 41: Two Types of Armadillos with a Marmoset, a Coconut Palm, and a Pepper Plant
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of two armadillos, a small primate, and various plants. The painting shows a detailed depiction of an armadillo perched on a rock, another armadillo curled near a small body of water, and a small primate sitting on a branch above them. There are plants with fruit or nuts hanging and elongated red and black fruits near the water's edge. The composition is set within an oval frame with a soft and naturalistic use of color. The Latin text "PRINCIPVM PRECES" and "PRECES ARMATAE" accompany the illustration. The style resembles that of Maria Sibylla Merian.

artworks.title: Plate 42: Two Genets or Civet Cats with Tulips
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of two spotted animals among tulips. The painting depicts two small, spotted animals standing on a patch of earth. One of the animals is in a crouching position while the other sits upright. Their tails are long and also spotted. The setting includes three tulips of varying colors—pink, red, and orange—each with noticeable green leaves and stems. The background is minimal. The scene is encased within an oval, and Latin text is written above and around it. This is in the style of early natural history illustrations.

artworks.title: Plate 43: Mongoose and Badger with Fruit Trees
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of a mongoose and a badger beside a river, surrounded by fruit-bearing trees. The image features two animals in a naturalistic style, with the left side showing a mongoose by the water's edge, and on the right, a badger resting on a small grassy mound. The entire scene is encircled with an arboreal border showcasing branches with fruit. Above and below the circle are Latin inscriptions. This is in the style of medieval or Renaissance scientific illustrations, where both the animals and plants are depicted with a focus on detail and realism.

artworks.title: Plate 44: Polecat, Mink, and Ermine
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of various weasels depicted in a circular composition. The image features four weasels, each distinct in color and posture, within an oval frame. The top left shows a brown weasel poised on a bare tree branch. Below, a white weasel is curled up on a rock, looking directly ahead. To the right, another weasel with a darker coat stands on the same rock. Above them, on a branch with green leaves and red berries, rests a white weasel. The surrounding frame features intertwined branches. The painting has Latin text. The colors are naturalistic, highlighting the textures of fur and foliage with detailed precision.

artworks.title: Plate 45: Weasels, a Ferret, and a "Nut Mouse"
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting a group of animals, including various types of weasels. The animals are arranged in an oval motif on a blank page. At the center, there is a branch with two animals perched on it. Below them, near a small body of water, another creature resembling an otter is depicted. A smaller animal is seen next to the water. To the right, standing separately on a patch of grass, is another animal resembling a polecat. The painting includes the text "Firmavit domini's orbem terrœ quı non commovebitvr" at the top and the Roman numerals "XXXV" on the right. The style reflects Renaissance naturalist illustrations, known for detailed and realistic portrayals of animals, reminiscent of Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: Plate 46: Stone Marten, Chipmunk, and Moles with a Marigold and Lettuce
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald

artworks.title: Plate 47: A Hare, "Jackalope," a Rabbit, and a Spotted Squirrel
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This is a painting of four rabbit-like animals within an oval outline. In the center is an animal that looks like a pale brown rabbit but has small antlers growing in front of its ears. This animal faces the right, towards a golden-brown rabbit that faces the antlered creature. On the far left is a darker brown animal that has a smaller head than the rabbit and slightly longer ears. It is turned slightly to the right. These three animals all sit on a curved, narrow piece of green earth with intricate root systems extending from its underside. Above these three, towards the top right, is a smaller creature that stands on what may be a brown root or branch, its front legs extended outward as if in mid-leap. This animal is smaller than the others and has a long bushy tail. Its fur is white and reddish-brown. The background of the painting is beige paper. Outside of the oval surrounding the painting are some lines of Latin text above, below, and to the right.

artworks.title: Plate 48: Guinea Pig and Hedgehogs with Melon and Cobnuts
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This painting shows two animals in an oval frame, both standing on a brown branch, facing the left. On the left is a rodent-like creature with smooth fur that is mostly cream-colored, but with spots of pale yellow and black on its face and back. On the right is a hedgehog with spiky brown and gray quills. Below the branch they stand on is a melon with green stripes surrounded by large green leaves. On the right, the branch merges with a patch of pale green ground, upon which is a spiky gray ball, possibly a second hedgehog that has curled up to show its spikes. Above the animals is a branch with acorns, flowers, and a small sign hanging down, and at the bottom of the painting is a small pond at the bottom right of the circular frame, adding a splash of blue. The background is off-white paper, and outside of the oval border there are several lines of Latin text.

artworks.title: Plate 4: Llama and Moose
artworks.medium: watercolor and gold paint on parchment
artworks.dimensions: page size (approximate): 14.3 x 18.4 cm (5 5/8 x 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Lessing J. Rosenwald
artworks.description: This painting features two animals standing between two trees. One animal resembles a camel without a hump, while the other is a smaller creature that could resemble a boar. Each animal is labeled with a number. The scene is within an oval frame, with one tree bearing yellow fruits and green leaves while the other has reddish fruits and lighter green leaves. The background shows grass and a slight mound. The style is akin to a scientific or natural history illustration.
